pool.text: Barovier and Toso was formed as one of the oldest companies.
The devastating Black Death struck Venice, causing immense suffering and loss of life.
Sultan Mehmet The Conqueror took the city after the Byzantine Empire was weakened.
Aldus Manutius established the Aldine Press, one of Italy's earliest printing presses.
The Aldine Press issued the first printed work of Aristotle.
Daniel Bomberg printed the first complete and uncensored printed edition of the Talmud.
The international art cinematography festival was founded by a count.
The activities of the Biennale were interrupted by the war.
British Eighth Army troops under Lieutenant General Freyberg liberated Venice.
The lagoon and the city were inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The city established a partnership with a Greek association.
The city signed a cultural promotion agreement with a ministry.
Qingdao in China established a science and technology partnership agreement.
Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi inaugurated the MOSE Project experimental engineering model.
The city opened the Ponte della Costituzione, the fourth bridge across the Grand Canal.
Venice announced the desire to end a sister city relationship.
Venice suffered severe flooding when waters peaked at 1.87 metres.
The cruise ship MSC Opera rammed a tourist riverboat docked on the Giudecca Canal.
MOSE was activated for the first time in response to a predicted high-tide event.
Venetian glass trade beads were found at prehistoric Inuit sites.
